install_steps: Ubuntu/Debian: sudo add-apt-repository ppa:hlandau/rhea && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install acmetool
sudo acmetool quickstart (sets up account, cronjob, etc.)
note: Single-file dependency-free binary. Supports Debian/Ubuntu (PPA), Arch Linux (AUR), RPM (copr), FreeBSD (ports), and manual binary download. Source: https://github.com/hlandau/acmetool (2.1k+ stars). Written in Go.
